Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler rejected my request because the Gateway has no credentials configured for cron (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`). Nothing is scheduled yet, so no digest will post on Monday 19 October unless someone with Gateway access fixes that and I set it up again.

Here's what I'd set up once the scheduler works:

- **When:** Mondays at 08:00 America/Chicago (the company time zone), starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted in #coastal-team, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest reaches no one new.
- **What:** the previous week's posts from both channels, plus open customer items such as ticket numbers and open follow-ups.
- **Left out:** money terms and finance documents. Those go to Anselm, June and the account owner, not to a channel.

If you want something different, such as another time or a different start date, tell me and I'll set it up as soon as the scheduler is available.
